The excitement of the playoffs is palpable, with every game feeling like a do-or-die battle for survival. Injuries can pile up, and exhaustion can set in, but the desire to win the ultimate prize keeps players pushing themselves to their limits. It's a thrilling and exhausting experience that only the best teams are able to survive and emerge victorious.

description:
With the Boston Bruins leading 3-1 in the series, Brad Marchand gets a breakaway in the last seconds of the third period in Game 5 with a chance to put Boston into the Second Round. Closing in on Sergei Bobrovsky, Marchand shoots the puck from inside the hashmarks right in the slot with just under one second remaining. Bobrovsky comes up with the game-saving stop and Florida would later go on to win that game and ultimately the series. Bobrovsky stopped 44 of 47 shots against for the Game 5 victory.

description:
With rookie Wyatt Johnston in behind the defense, Evgenii Dadonov lofts the puck over everyone deep into the far corner where the puck kicks back out to Johnston just above the goal line. Johnston then shifts the puck to his backhand where he roofs it top corner on the short side for a 2-0 Dallas lead with just over seven minutes remaining in Game 7 vs Seattle. With the goal, Johnston became the youngest player in history to score a game winning goal in a Game 7.

description:
In front of a standing crowd in Florida, the Panthers are on a power play in the last minute of the third period of a tie game. At the blueline, Matthew Tkachuk feeds a cross-ice pass to Sam Reinhart who throws the puck at the net which redirects right off the crossbar to Aleksander Barkov. Meanwhile, during that time after Tkachuk makes the pass, he heads towards the net and curls behind it where he gets a pass from Barkov. Tkachuk then swivels around to the front in the slot where he scores with less than five seconds remaining for the series-winning goal. During the 2023 Stanley Cup Playoffs, Tkachuk netted four game-winning goals of which three were in overtime and one clinched a series.

description:
In the first minute of the second period of Game 1 during the Stanley Cup Final, Adin Hill makes a remarkable save on Nick Cousins to keep the score tied at one. The play begins with a 4-on-3 rush for Florida over the blueline. In a tic-tac-toe passing play, Sam Bennett drops the puck to Brandon Montour who feeds Matthew Tkachuk on the far side. Tkachuk then one-touches the puck to Nick Cousins in the slot who is staring at a wide-open net. Out of nowhere, Adin Hill reaches out with the paddle of his stick to stop a sure goal. Vegas would then go on to win the game 5-2 with Hill registering 32 saves on 35 shots.

description:
Maple Leafs captain John Tavares nets the overtime winner in Game 6, advancing Toronto to the second round of the playoffs for the first time since 2004. The Greater Toronto Area-native Tavares begins the play with a good keep at the blueline sending it in deep to rookie Matthew Knies. Knies then gets the puck back to Tavares who is continuing behind the net. Protecting the puck, he gets out to the faceoff dot before turning around and sending a shot toward the net that gets redirected by a Tampa Bay skate into the net.

description:
The Seattle Kraken won their first-ever playoff series going seven games versus the Colorado Avalanche. In doing so, they became the first NHL expansion team to eliminate the defending champions in their playoff debut. In Game 7 in Denver, Oliver Bjorkstrand scored both goals for Seattle in their thrilling 2-1 win. On the series-winning goal, the play begins with a nice chip off the wall by teammate Eeli Tolvanen who beat the pinching defenseman to the puck. Headed up the ice with speed, Bjorkstrand gains possession of the puck just inside Colorado’s blueline where he gains inside positioning and snaps a shot post-and-in for his second goal of the game.

description:
In the middle of the second period in Edmonton, Jack Eichel picks up the puck along the boards in the defensive zone. Making a nice inside-to-outside crossover, Eichel gets around Evan Bouchard. Now 2-on-1, Eichel holds onto the puck and wrists the puck far side to put Vegas up by three for his fifth goal of the playoffs. Eichel registered a goal and two helpers alongside a plus-3 rating in the game earning him First Star of the Game honors. In his first ever playoffs, Eichel led the league in points (26) and assists (20) while also finishing with a plus-14 rating.

description:
In overtime of Game 3 with the New York Rangers winning the first two during the First Round series against their cross-river rivals, Dougie Hamilton scores a huge goal for the New Jersey Devils that gets them back in the series. On the play, it begins with Nico Hischier moving the puck to Jesper Bratt who gains the blueline. Bratt then buys some time and spins to pass the puck over to the trailing Hamilton who roofs it top shelf over the glove of Igor Shesterkin. The Devils would later go on to win the series in seven games.

description:
In Game 5 of the 2023 Stanley Cup Final for Vegas, Mark Stone scored a hat trick and became the first team captain in history to do so in a Cup-clinching game. In his first goal featured in this highlight, it begins on a Vegas penalty kill in the middle of the first period. Stone pounces on a Florida turnover made at the blueline where he picks up the puck in the neutral zone with speed. Now headed on a two-on-one, he displays great patience and awareness with the puck by slowing up and allowing the defender to go down and commit to the pass. Stone then roofs it top shelf over Bobrovsky’s glove for the shorty which is the first goal of the game and tilted the momentum towards Vegas. Stone would later go on to net the hatty with an empty netter in the third period.
